parsed.rationale: Both `HLSRateDidChangeMessage.makeNotification` (line 38 in `HLSPlayerMessages.swift`) and `PlayerRateDidChangeMessage.makeNotification` (line 42 in `RadioPlayerMessages.swift`) are flagged as exact function duplicates within the same `Playback` package. Because the implementations are identical and both live in the same package, the idiomatic Swift approach is to introduce a shared protocol (e.g., `RateDidChangeMessage`) with a default implementation of `makeNotification` in a protocol extension, then have both message types conform to it and delete their individual implementations. This eliminates the duplication without moving code across package boundaries.
